page_title: BOL 1-1 NAP | Bologna v Napoli 07/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Davide Massa is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
90+2' The foul by Michel Aebischer (Bologna) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Davide Massa.
90+2' It is time for a substitution. Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) is on for Matteo Politano.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Emil Holm (Bologna) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header into the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
90' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bologna.
89' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Bologna force their opponents to concede a corner.
89' A yellow card for a tackle by Frank Anguissa (Napoli). Davide Massa doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
87' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Jens Odgaard is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
87' Dan Ndoye comes off the pitch to be replaced by Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna).
86' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
86' Davide Massa interrupts the game. One of the players from Napoli won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Free kick. Bologna will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
82' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
81' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
80' Juan Miranda (Bologna) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Simone Scuffet to dive and make a save.
79' Today's referee Davide Massa rightly decides to book Mathias Olivera (Napoli) for his harsh tackle.
78' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Bologna.
77' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Thijs Dallinga and he is replaced by Santiago Castro (Bologna).
77' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Riccardo Orsolini will be replaced by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna).
75' A cross by Jens Odgaard (Bologna) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
74' Substitution. David Neres makes his way off the pitch and Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) comes on as his replacement.
73' Davide Massa blows his whistle and it's David Neres (Napoli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. There is a free kick near the sideline to Bologna.
71' Rough tackle by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli have a free kick.
70' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is being substituted because of an injury. Cristian Stellini sends Billy Gilmour on the pitch.

68' It looks like Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) saw red with that tackle. Davide Massa won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Bologna are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
67' Emil Holm (Bologna) serves up a nice cross, but Simone Scuffet punches the ball away.
67' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
64' 1 - 1 Dan Ndoye (Bologna) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb in the roof of the net. What a perfect shot.
64' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Emil Holm (Bologna).
63' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Bologna, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
63' Juan Miranda (Bologna) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
61' The foul by Jens Odgaard (Bologna) was seen by Davide Massa who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. It's a free kick to Napoli, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

60' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
60' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Davide Massa ignores the protests.
59' There's an opportunity for Juan Miranda (Bologna) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
58' Emil Holm (Bologna) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Bologna will take a corner kick.
56' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

56' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Davide Massa with no other option than to blow for a foul. Bologna are awarded the free kick.
54' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. Napoli earn a free kick.
53' Emil Holm (Bologna) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
53' Emil Holm (Bologna) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
51' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Davide Massa blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Napoli in a dangerous position.
50' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Davide Massa had a clear view and blows his whistle. Bologna are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
50' David Neres (Napoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
49' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
49' Juan Miranda (Bologna) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
49' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Davide Massa blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+4' What a chance that is! Michel Aebischer (Bologna) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
45+3' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
45+3' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick is awarded to Bologna.
45+2' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+1' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
43' Davide Massa blows for a foul after Mathias Olivera (Napoli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Bologna will take a free kick near the side line.
41' Matteo Politano (Napoli) is caught offside!
41' Matteo Politano (Napoli) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
40' Juan Miranda (Bologna) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
40' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) brings his opponent down. Davide Massa has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Bologna will take a free kick.
40' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
38' Matteo Politano (Napoli) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Lukasz Skorupski comes off the line to clear the ball away.

37' The game is interrupted. Michel Aebischer (Bologna) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Napoli win a free kick.
36' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but Simone Scuffet comes off his line to gather the ball.
36' An attempted cross from Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is cleared.
35' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends a long ball in, but Simone Scuffet comfortably gathers the ball.
34' Matteo Politano (Napoli) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
34' Good work from Napoli as they win a corner.

33' Excellent touch by Scott McTominay (Napoli)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save. The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
32' Davide Massa has a clear sight and sees a foul from Thijs Dallinga (Bologna). Napoli are awarded a free kick.

31' Scott McTominay (Napoli) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
31' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
29' Davide Massa couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Michel Aebischer (Bologna) and blew his whistle. Napoli win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
29' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Simone Scuffet comes off the line to clear the ball away.
28' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
27' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
27' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
26' Juan Jesus (Napoli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! A free kick has been awarded to Bologna.
25' Federico Ravaglia (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lukasz Skorupski.
23' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
23' A cross from Michel Aebischer (Bologna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
20' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

18' 0 - 1 Frank Anguissa (Napoli) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Lukasz Skorupski is just a bystander as the ball flies low into the middle of the goal. The score is 0:1.
18' Dangerous play by Dan Ndoye (Bologna). Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli have a free kick.
17' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Simone Scuffet, who smothers the ball.
17' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. A free kick to Bologna.
16' Emil Holm (Bologna) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.

14' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked David Neres (Napoli) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
12' The ball is cleared after David Neres (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
11' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
10' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
10' Bologna fail to score from a corner as Simone Scuffet (Napoli) leaps to collect the ball. The ball is out of play and Bologna manage to earn a corner.
10' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bologna.
9' Juan Miranda (Bologna) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
9' Juan Miranda (Bologna) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

8' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bologna are going to take it.
5' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Bologna have been awarded a free kick.
4' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) makes a strong challenge and Davide Massa blows for a foul. Napoli get a free kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a chip pass into the box, but Lukasz Skorupski is quickest to intercept the ball.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Napoli will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Davide Massa.
